source: Weekly refresh by Claude (scheduled task). Edit freely; the next refresh replaces this file.

items.title: Soweto Marathon (29 Nov): shoot the start at Nasrec and post a same-day reel
items.why: It is one of the biggest sport events in Joburg this season and runners love finding photos of themselves.
items.tip: Post a 'find yourself' carousel too and tell runners to tag their friends.

items.title: Springbok match day: shoot a pub or braai viewing crowd
items.why: The Boks play Italy, France and Ireland in November, so fan content will be everywhere in SA feeds.
items.tip: Capture reactions in slow motion at the big moments and cut on the crowd noise.

items.title: Black Friday mini-session offer for families and brands
items.why: Black Friday is 27 November and people are already hunting for deals that double as Christmas gifts.
items.tip: Slide 1 is the offer, slide 2 sample photos, last slide is how to book with a deadline.

items.title: Slow motion 'entrance' reel for athletes and cars
items.why: Dramatic slow motion walk-ins and roll-ins keep showing up as a strong TikTok and Reels format.
items.tip: Shoot at 120fps, low angle, and drop the beat on the first full frame of the subject.

items.title: Camera flip reveal: BTS that turns around to show the final shot
items.why: Planned camera reveal transitions are trending and suit photographers who can time a clean cut.
items.tip: Rehearse the move twice so the flip lands on your best frame.

items.title: Send-worthy reel: one clip people would DM to a friend
items.why: DM sends are still one of the strongest signals for reaching people who do not follow you.
items.tip: End with a line like 'send this to the friend who needs new headshots'.

items.title: Post only your own original work, no reposted clips
items.why: Instagram now cuts reach for accounts that mostly repost, and this applies to photos and carousels too.
items.tip: If you share a client's video, add your own edit or BTS so it counts as new.

items.title: Headshot vs candid split: 'who they show LinkedIn' vs real life
items.why: Before and after contrast edits work well and show off both your posed and candid skills.
items.tip: Use a hard cut on the beat and keep each half under 2 seconds.

items.title: Year-end function teaser for venues and caterers
items.why: November and December are peak work party and event season in South Africa.
items.tip: Tag the venue and caterer so they reshare to their audience.

items.title: Trial reel test: try a new hook on non-followers first
items.why: Trial Reels let you test ideas on new viewers without cluttering your main grid.
items.tip: Keep the one with the best watch time and share it to followers.
